race.comment: AMALFI DREAMER (5) was well fancied on debut but let the leader slip away before finishing off strongly into third. Is sure to have come on from that and can settle closer from the kinder draw this time. GRAND MILLESIME (8) has been okay without impressing this prep but should appreciate the rise in trip. Think she can improve sharply. STREET LEGAL (2) finds the maiden win elusive but it certainly hasn't been without trying. Doesn't need to improve much to win but has become costly. TORPEDOES (3) has mixed his form this prep but boasts solid peaks. Freshened with a month in between, kept up to the mark with a jumpout. Can give this a big shake. SHE'S ICONNIC (10) was no match for the winner but tried hard to finish a distant second fresh. Has jumped out well in-between runs and is still lightly raced so can improve sharply.
